goal.description: Optional caller-supplied task criteria, evaluated separately from execution. Omitted object IDs bind to the selected observation/action pair. These criteria are not independently verified as the human user's intent.

query.description: Select task facts, global surface_nearest, legacy overview/exact_pairs/nearest/top1, or registered mesh reads. Legacy exact_pairs/nearest/top1 may select object_ids and max_exact_pairs. nearest requires complete exact nonpenetrating order; top1 may prune by strict outward bounds and reports ties. Unknown/budget-limited proofs give no nearest result; reads grant no execution permission.

objects.description: Exact selectors bound to this capture; each contains name OR id. task: aabb uses 1..4; pair facts exactly two ordered A to B. surface_nearest: exactly one.

requested_facts.description: task only. closed_solid_relation: represented connected closed triangle shells at zero tolerance, separated/touching/penetrating (positive-volume interior overlap); invalid/ambiguous gives unknown with reasons. surface_proximity: independent nonnegative triangle-surface distance, original world points, positive-distance A-to-B direction and boundary/nonmanifold counts. Zero-distance direction is not applicable; edge counts do not certify solids. pair_relation: separation gap/points/direction, touching, or A's certified escape translation; escape is not surface distance, nearest direction or minimum depth.

operation.description: Registered single-target reads. mesh_structure: diagnose text or patch images. mesh_surface: local opt-in; diagnose/reference/restore_preview require include_image=false. reference_patch uses a returned opaque feature patch_ref and may request useful native images under the original task budget. Reference input is locally trusted; previews never execute. Caller labels never reset budgets.

task_ref.description: Required in locally controlled lifecycle mode; use the trusted begin handoff. Selects the active registered generation and never creates or renews a task.

label_object_ids.description: Optional current full object IDs to prioritize in paired image observations. Separate from measurement object_ids; expands only the related annotation budget, up to six related labels plus A/B. Missing pair, unrequested image, occlusion or undersampling is reported explicitly; never an action permission.

alignment_evidence.description: False explicitly requests strict distance evidence without optional face-alignment angles; requires include_image=false. Host rigid-frame and all action checks remain independent.

support_plane_discovery.description: Read-only discovery of bounded original support-plane selectors for the current focal/reference pair. Omit direction for geometry only; no action direction is invented.

native_visual.description: Display policy only; never execution permission. Auto uses a negotiated read-only native host, otherwise the analytical projection. Projection skips negotiation; multiscale requires support. Labels and contact sections require projection.

visual_diagnostic.description: Append an analytical full-mesh contact section beside the natural views; not natural visibility or an action permission.

include_image.description: False returns text evidence without rendering. mesh_structure diagnose requires false and reads only the registered target raw mesh; patch may explicitly request images. Other observation modes retain default true.

scene_delta.description: Optional observation-only snapshot transport. Empty object asks for full resync; a complete base revision and SHA256 enables a delta when worthwhile.

response_detail.description: Optional display projection. Brief preserves measurements, scopes, unknowns and native image bytes while omitting named camera/raster diagnostics. Full is a new current observation, not retrieval of a previous observation. Errors and insufficient savings keep full.
